Return only the one-paragraph video description without Markdown formatting or introductory text.

First, specify the **shot size** based on the subject's size in the frame if major subjects are present. If the shot size is unclear, describe how much of the subject is visible. If no major subject exists (e.g., a scenery shot), describe the shot size in relation to the scenery.

pre_caption: In this reverse-motion, low-angle shot, the scene initially shows broken eggshell fragments in the bottom center foreground on a reddish-brown surface. In the out-of-focus middle ground, the lower body of a person stands centrally, with a second person to the right, both set against a background of trees and a blue sky that occupies the upper frame. As the video plays, liquid and additional shell fragments move inward from the periphery and from off-screen, converging on the reddish-brown surface in the bottom center. This movement culminates with the formation of a single, whole brown egg, which comes to rest in a close-up view in the bottom center foreground, while the figures in the middle ground remain stationary. The camera maintains a fixed position level with the egg throughout the sequence.
